children.value: > Fact From Story: The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: The Securities and Exchange Commission alleges FTX was a fraud “from the start,” with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Fact From Story: SBF maintained his innocence.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People who are innocent do not commit fraud.
> > Fact From Story: SBF, as he’s known, has pleaded not-guilty to some seven charges of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: In a trial, evidence is presented to determine if someone is innocent or guilty of the charges they face.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A trial determines whether someone is guilty or not guilty.
